asserts.clickEval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('div[data-ledger-resolve-bar][data-request-id="{{requestId}}"] button[data-ledger-resolve-allow]'); if (!b || b.disabled) return 'false'; b.click(); return 'clicked' })()

asserts.eval: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[data-ledger-row][data-ledger-kind="control-decision"]')]; return rows.some((r) => { const b = r.querySelector('span[data-ledger-state][data-decision="deny"][data-external-policy="true"]'); if (!b) return false; const team = b.querySelector('[data-external-policy-team-decision]')?.textContent.trim(); const execution = b.querySelector('[data-external-policy-execution]')?.textContent.trim(); const frozenEn = team === 'Team decision: Allowed' && execution === 'Execution: Blocked by managed policy'; const frozenZh = team === '团队裁决：已允许' && execution === '执行：被托管策略阻止'; const plainDenied = b.textContent.includes('Denied') || b.textContent.includes('拒绝'); return (frozenEn || frozenZh) && !plainDenied }) })()
